name: Seduced by the Sorority Sister
source:
Skylar Moore is blonde, beautiful and the hottest girl on campus. She'd be perfect for you--if she wasn't also the cheerleading captain who made your life hell in high school. But you can't stay in college unless you join her sorority! Can you become a sorority sister without falling for your worst enemy? Or will you be seduced by Skylar?

[From in-app]
translation:
斯凯拉·摩尔 (Skylar Moore) 金发碧眼，美丽动人，是校园里最炙手可热的女孩。她对你来说是完美的——如果她不是在高中时让你的生活变得一团糟的啦啦队队长的话。但除非你加入她的联谊会，否则你不能留在大学！你能成为联谊会姐妹而不陷入最大的敌人吗？或者你会被Skylar诱惑吗？

[来自应用程序内]
